intro: These words come from the Cherokee Phoenix (1828–1834), commonly described as the first Native American newspaper. It was printed in Sequoyah's syllabary. The small pictures under a highlighted letter show how this paper printed it.
name: Cherokee

notes.Ꮎ: at the start of a word this paper prints it as a plain G (the first two pictures); inside a word it looks like θ (the last)
notes.Ꮩ: this paper prints it as Λ, an A with no crossbar

title: Cherokee Phoenix
